rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a cathedral, including a large church building and the principal church of a diocese.

example.traditional: 呢座大教堂真係好宏偉。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 daai6 gaau3 tong4 zan1 hai6 hou2 wang4 wai5

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the church is the official seat of a bishop or archbishop.

example.english: This cathedral is the official seat of the bishop of the diocese.
example.traditional: 呢座主教座堂係本教區主教嘅辦公地點。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 zyu2 gaau3 zo6 tong4 hai6 bun2 gaau3 keoi1 zyu2 gaau3 ge3 baan6 gung1 dei6 dim2
